article.headline: Jayden Harris scores 28, UMass-Lowell defeats Hampton 72-55 at Capital Thanksgiving Classic
article.description: — Jayden Harris’ 28 points and nine rebounds helped UMass-Lowell defeat Hampton 72-55 on Friday at the Capital Thanksgiving Classic.
article.linkText: Jayden Harris scores 28, UMass-Lowell defeats Hampton 72-55 at Capital Thanksgiving Classic

keywords: UMass Lowell River Hawks @ Hampton Pirates
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Jayden Harris’ 28 points and nine rebounds helped UMass-Lowell defeat Hampton 72-55 on Friday at the Capital Thanksgiving Classic. Christian Jones scored 14 points while shooting 3 for 10 (0 for 4 from 3-point range) and 8 of 8 from the free-throw line for the River Hawks (5-2). Jakai Newton went 5 of 9 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 12 points, while adding 11 rebounds and five assists. Seth Hubbard led the Pirates (1-5) in scoring, finishing with 16 points and two steals. Max Frazier added 11 points for Hampton. Etienne Strothers finished with 10 points. UMass-Lowell took the lead a little over a minute into the game and did not trail again. Harris led the River Hawks with 11 points in the first half to help put them up 36-25 at the break. UMass-Lowell outscored Hampton by six points in the second half, and Harris scored a team-high 17 points in the second half to help their team secure the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
